newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Telstra to pay News over Foxtel - paper.
newsitem.headline: Telstra to pay News over Foxtel - paper.

text.p: News Corp Ltd will receive A$100 million in compensation from its pay-television partner Telstra Corporation as part of a proposal to limit the cable rollout of their Foxtel partnership to three million homes, the Australian Financial Review newspaper said on Tuesday.
The paper said the deal would also involve state-owned Telstra providing additional cash to bolster the balance sheet of the Foxtel pay-tv venture.
The partners had planned for the cable rollout to pass four million homes, but only two million have been achieved to date.
The paper also said Foxtel and satellite pay-tv operator Australis Media Ltd might merge, with Kerry Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd playing a key role in brokering the talks.
PBL is a major financial backer of the loss-making Australis.
